subject: Architecture
title: Frank Lloyd Wright: Architecture Meets Nature
description: A 60-second lesson on Frank Lloyd Wright: Architecture Meets Nature.

hook.text: A client asked Frank Lloyd Wright for a house with a view of the waterfall. Wright built it over the waterfall.

buildup.text: Fallingwater's concrete balconies cantilever over the stream, blending house and landscape.

discovery.text: Wright called his approach 'organic architecture' — buildings should grow from their sites.

twist.text: The balconies sagged almost immediately. Engineers quietly added steel supports Wright hadn't planned.

climax.text: Despite its flaws, Fallingwater was named the best building of the 20th century by the AIA.

punchline.text: The house leaks, sags, and bends. Nobody cares. It's perfect.

quiz.question: What did Wright call his philosophy of architecture?
